name: x-defense-3
effect: Used on a party Pokémon in battle : Raises the target’s Defense by three stages. This item can only be obtained or used via the Wonder Launcher.
short_effect: Raises Defense by three stages in battle. Wonder Launcher only.

flavor_text.sword-shield: It drastically raises the Defense stat of a Pokémon in battle. It wears off if the Pokémon is withdrawn.
